## Review

- [ ] Manifest and catalog metadata match; all checksums cover exact committed bytes.
- [ ] Only supported JSON data is included; no executable entry or install hook.
- [ ] Existing package identities and language locales do not conflict.
- [ ] Files and reachable commit metadata contain no credentials, personal data or private organization content.
- [ ] Any previews use synthetic data.
